author: Matt Wolfe
description:
This polarized the internet. 

OpenAI made waves after releasing ChatGPT Health last week. It can help explain symptoms, conditions, medications, and lab results in plain language. 

I know I'm not the only one who has asked medical or health questions to ChatGPT before, but this really divided the internet. A lot of people see this as a way to fill in the healthcare gap in this country, while many other say they wouldn't trust an AI company with their health data. 

What side are you on? 👇🏻

#AI #ChatGPT #ChatGPTHealth
title: What's The Deal With ChatGPT Health?
